title: Why Divorce Costs You $20,000 (The Paperwork Is $300)
alts: The Real Cost of Divorce: $300 in Forms or $20,000 at Trial?
One Question Cut This Divorce Bill in Half ($9,800 Saved)
line1: Dave's neighbor Bob got a lawyer bill for fighting over a couch. The couch cost $400. The bill was $516. We follow every dollar.
summary: Bob starts a divorce thinking it'll cost three hundred dollars in forms. Then his wife hires a lawyer, so Bob panics and hires one too. The first bill arrives: one and a half hours on the gray couch. Bob's lawyer charges three hundred forty four dollars an hour. Five hundred sixteen dollars to argue about a four hundred dollar couch. Every email both lawyers send, both bill for it. Two lawyers times three forty four equals six hundred eighty eight dollars per hour of arguing. After ten hours billed, Bob's already at three thousand four hundred forty dollars and nothing's decided. The villain: the hourly clock. It gets paid whether you win or lose. The CDC counted six hundred seventy two thousand divorces in twenty twenty three. The Martindale Nolo survey shows couples with lawyers who agreed on everything paid about four thousand one hundred dollars. Fought but settled: ten thousand six hundred. Trial on one issue: twenty thousand four hundred. Bob almost goes to trial over the house and plans to cash out his four oh one k early to pay his wife her half. That triggers income tax plus a ten percent IRS penalty. Dave sticks a sticky note on every item on Bob's fight list. The same question: is this worth an hour of two lawyers? Bob drops the couch and the TV. Six hundred eighty eight per hour. For the big stuff, mediation costs three to ten thousand split between them, and courts often offer free or low cost mediation. A QDRO moves his wife's share of the four oh one k with no ten percent penalty. Six weeks later Bob walks out of mediation with a settlement. His final bill lands close to the ten thousand six hundred fought then settled average instead of the twenty thousand four hundred trial step. He saved about nine thousand eight hundred dollars. The paperwork really does cost about three hundred. Everything after that is the price of the fight.
